name: Sangiran Early Man Site
description: Sangiran is a roughly 56 square kilometre stretch of the Solo River valley in Central Java, about 15 kilometres north of Surakarta. Erosion has sliced open an ancient uplifted dome and exposed fossil-rich layers. Digs here have turned up Homo erectus remains, about half of the world's known hominid fossils, from people who lived here over a million years ago.
